text:
Matvei Gridin is 20, in his second NHL season, and producing like a regular. He has 6 goals and 13 points in 21 games, 5 of the points on the power play, and Calgary has been handing him more ice: 17.3 minutes a night over his last ten, up 2.23. Forwards picked in his range of the draft (23rd to 33rd overall) scored a median 0.35 points a game in their first full season; he's at 0.62 so far.

The numbers underneath are honest. He's shooting 13.6%, right at the league norm, and his on-ice luck is close to neutral. At five on five the Flames have had 51.71% of the expected goals with him on, 7.09 points better than without him. The soft spot is his own chance creation, 0.69 expected goals per hour, which is modest for his points.

He's fast (speed bursts in the 92nd percentile by NHL EDGE), and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him carrying the puck in on 61% of his entries in a small sample of 8 tracked games. Watch whether the shot quality climbs with the bigger role.
headline: Matvei Gridin is ahead of schedule
